findings.evidence: the tail is almost entirely foreign neighbourhoods, and the parent topic gives the reason: restaurants a north end 500, restaurants a covent garden 500, restaurants a prenzlauer berg 400, restaurants a east village 350, restaurants a hayes valley 350, restaurants a wannsee 300, restaurants a pilsen 300, restaurants a buckhead 250, restaurants a little five points 250, restaurants a west village 250, restaurants a atlantic station 200, restaurants a harlem 200, restaurants a leith 200, restaurants a temple bar 200, restaurants a rembrandtplein 150, restaurants a kreuzberg 150, restaurants a adams morgan 150, restaurants a dupont circle 150, restaurants a kowloon tong 150, restaurants a noe valley 150, restaurants a mission bay park 150, restaurants a pacific beach 150, restaurants a soho 100, restaurants a lantau island 100, restaurants a hung hom 100, restaurants a grassmarket 100, restaurants a east atlanta 100. Most carry the parent topic restaurants pres de {place}, which is proximity intent from a traveller already there. Only four domestic French rows clear the floor: meilleurs restaurants a paris 200, restaurants a montmartre 150, restaurants a montparnasse 100, restaurants a provins 100.
findings.reading: French domestic restaurant search does not go to list pages at this volume. The demand that exists is travel and expatriate demand about cities outside France, which the destination axis already owns. Building restaurants a {french city} would be building for measured silence.
